identification: Yamaha alto saxophone with brown hard case and a folding saxophone stand. Gold lacquered brass body, nickel-plated keys, mother-of-pearl key touches, Yamaha tuning-fork logo engraved on the neck (confirmed in a zoom of photo 3). The look (lacquered body, nickel keys, student build) is consistent with the Yamaha YAS-21 / YAS-23 / AS-100 type student altos, but the YAS model stamp and the serial number are NOT legible in any of the 5 photos (bell engraving in photo 4 is visible but too small and blurred to read; no photo shows the neck receiver or the body under the thumb hook). Model is therefore unconfirmed.
